thread:
alex: FYI — planning a coordinated deploy for search + rerank + user-profiles at 02:00 UTC. We'll use staged FF toggles to enable search-v2. Starting with 5% cohorts and observability checks.

maya: ETA for window? any blackout for dashboards? :eyes:

alex: Window 02:00-03:00 UTC. No dashboard blackout, but prometheus scrape cadence will be 10s for the run. Pinning search service to image tag search:v2-rc3 for the canary cohort.

samir: Adding rollback criteria here: if p95 latency on search increases >150ms over baseline OR error-rate >0.5% for 3 consecutive 1m buckets, we drain cohort and revert FF back to previous. Also abort if rerank QPS drops >10%.

ingrid: Suggest we do 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m soak at each step. Keep model cache warm on canary nodes to avoid cold-start spikes.

alex: Agreed. Plan: 02:00 — deploy images and pin versions. 02:05 — enable search-v2 ff at 5% (region: us-east-1). 02:20 — promote to 25% if health good. 02:40 — 100% rollout and unpin older tag at 02:50.

maya: Who's owning the safety cut? I'll monitor traces + SLO board. @samir you own rollback exec?

samir: I'll handle rollback. I'll pre-stage the revert playbook and a quick command: `deploy-bot rollback --service search --tag search:v1.9.4 --reason "ff regression"`

alex: Also we should set the deploy-bot toggle commands in the thread so ops can run them quickly. Putting the exact commands below.

alex: ```
# enable 5% cohort for search-v2
/deploy-bot ff set --flag search-v2 --cohort us-east-1:5
# promote to 25%
/deploy-bot ff set --flag search-v2 --cohort us-east-1:25
# full enable
/deploy-bot ff set --flag search-v2 --cohort us-east-1:100
# emergency disable
/deploy-bot ff unset --flag search-v2 --all
```

deploy-bot: [INFO] scheduled deploy pipeline #dp-2026-229 at 02:00 UTC. Artifact pins: search=search:v2-rc3, rerank=rerank:2026-02-12, profiles=profiles:stable-7.

ingrid: Add a quick smoke test after each step: 10 synthetic queries with expected top-3 rerank stability. Fail conditions should mark the step unhealthy.

maya: Will run smoke harness and post results in this thread. Quick note: keep a hold on DB schema migrations — none are planned but double-check.

samir: Prepped a rollback checklist and a short note for on-call:
- Revert FF to previous cohort weights
- Pin traffic routing back to search:v1.9.4
- Run `kubectl rollout restart` for search service if lingering connections
- Notify partners and customer-success

alex: Release notes snippet (to paste into changelog):
"Search better-relevance v2 (gradual rollout). Initial canary in us-east-1 at 5%. Observability gating and automatic rollback on SLA regressions."

maya: One more: set temporary alert suppressions for noisy canary spikes so we don't page on known warmup behavior. Suppress for 20m windows aligned with each step.

ingrid: I'll add guardrails in the console: automatic rollback rule (p95 > 150ms) and disable auto-scale spike policies to avoid extra nodes skewing metrics.

deploy-bot: [INFO] pipeline dp-2026-229 started 02:00:12 UTC. Stage: deploy artifacts -> pin images -> health checks.

alex: If everyone is good, we'll proceed. Say :thumbsup: to acknowledge.

maya: :thumbsup:

samir: :thumbsup: — standing by for rollback if needed.

ingrid: :thumbsup: monitoring dashboards are up.

alex: Great. I'll post a short post-deploy summary in #release-notes after 03:00 UTC.

(END)
